title: Open 20.5

description: For time, partitioned any way: 40 ring muscle-ups, 80-calorie row and 120 wall balls (20/14 lb to 10/9 ft), 20-minute cap. You choose the order and the set sizes. Scaled used chin-over-bar pull-ups and a 14/10 lb ball.
